mapper.select: SELECT case_id,order_id,order_line_id,merchant_id,product_id,quantity,kind,warehouse_id,outbound_id FROM inventory_line_credits WHERE case_id=#{caseId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM inventory_line_credits WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_line_id=#{orderLineId} AND kind='RETURN' AND COALESCE(warehouse_id,1)=COALESCE(#{warehouseId},1)
AND (outbound_id=#{outboundId} OR outbound_id IS NULL)
